question: May the weakly adversarial SWIXQSM generator (C2) replace the L1-only U-Net as the primary reported model?

candidate.label: C2
candidate.description: Wave C run 'C2 adv0.1': SWIXQSM generator, lambda_l1=100, lambda_adv=0.1, checkpoint best_gan.pt (val best at GAN epoch 31)

comparator.label: plain_unet
comparator.description: Wave A plain_unet: same generator family, lambda_l1=1, lambda_adv=0, checkpoint best_l1.pt (val best at epoch 83)

default_rule_before_this_registration: The Wave A/B/C protocol selects by val stored_participant_equal_mae; under that rule plain_unet is primary.
not_computed_before_registration: high-frequency power ratio, high-frequency correlation and SD ratio on any split
any prediction, voxel metric or ROI value of C2 or plain_unet in the external cohorts

internal.unit_of_analysis: participant; visits pooled within participant before equal weighting

high_frequency.definition: h = x - S(x), S = in-plane Gaussian smoothing normalized by the smoothed evaluation mask (no smoothing across slices, matching the 2D generator)
high_frequency.support: evaluation-mask voxels whose smoothed mask weight is >= interior_weight

endpoints.delta_mae: MAE(C2) - MAE(plain_unet), evaluation mask, input storage units
endpoints.delta_abs_log_hf_power_ratio: |log(sum h_C2^2 / sum h_ref^2)| - |log(sum h_plain^2 / sum h_ref^2)|; negative means C2 high-frequency energy is closer to the reference
endpoints.delta_hf_correlation: pearson(h_C2, h_ref) - pearson(h_plain, h_ref) over the high-frequency support

A_mae_noninferiority.rule: upper CI bound of mean delta_mae < mae_margin_fraction_of_gain * mean(MAE(zero) - MAE(plain_unet))

B_less_oversmoothing.rule: upper CI bound of mean delta_abs_log_hf_power_ratio < 0

C_no_loss_of_correct_detail.rule: lower CI bound of mean delta_hf_correlation > -hf_correlation_margin

external.participants: Shunyi roi_primary and CSVD roi_primary passing the prespecified MuSus registration QC
external.roi_aggregation: bilateral voxel-count-weighted mean in the reference QSM grid

D_external_roi_noninferiority.rule: mean over ROIs of ICC(A,1)(C2 vs reference) >= mean over ROIs of ICC(A,1)(plain_unet vs reference) - icc_margin, both cohorts pooled, computed once

decision.c2_primary_if: A, B, C and D all hold
decision.otherwise: plain_unet is primary; C2 is reported as the best adversarial variant
decision.reporting: Both models appear in every internal and external table regardless of the decision; no endpoint, threshold or ROI is added, removed or changed after this file is hashed

disclosure: Margin A was set after the internal val/test MAE point estimates were known; criterion A therefore carries little evidential weight and must be described as such.
Criteria B, C and D were defined before their endpoints were computed on any data.
Wave runs deviated from the written Wave B/C plan (50 instead of 30 epochs; C1 and C3 configurations differ from the plan); these deviations are reported in the supplement.
